reasons.correctness: Implements the repository derived query, the service method returning the count with a now-minus-days cutoff, and the cron job with enabled/days/cron properties and defaults. The disabled flag skips work; failures are caught and logged. Hidden tests 4/4.
reasons.convention_fit: StaleTicketCloseCronJob has @SchedulerLock(name="support:staleTicketClose"), @Scheduled cron from a property, @Value enabled:true and @RequiredArgsConstructor. It sits in the support/ticket feature package, and properties were added to application.yml.
reasons.design_fit: Clean layering: the job delegates to the service and the repository owns the query. Unlike updateTicketStatus, closeStaleResolvedTickets does not set lastUpdateTime. It also calls save per ticket inside @Transactional, which is redundant for managed entities.
reasons.test_quality: SupportTicketServiceStaleCloseUnitTest covers closing with count, the cutoff via ArgumentCaptor, and the empty case. StaleTicketCloseCronJobUnitTest covers enabled delegation, disabled no-op and swallowed failure. Both use MockitoExtension with no Spring context.
reasons.graph_use: Before editing, graph queries located the supportticket files, the existing *CronJob.java examples, TESTED_BY tests and dependents. The agent then read InvoiceRetryCronJob and ConsentEnforcementCronJob and followed their structure.
